soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.55–0.56, the sides nearly parallel and slightly narrower in front of the middle, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The frontal ridge is slightly raised, the interfrontal area slightly concave, the middle of the dorsal margin of the head with a slight impression. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, its posterior part retracted within the clypeus, the semi-transparent apical region needle-like, bearing apical and subapical hairs. The mandibles are strong with strongly curved apices, the mandibular condyle distinct; the mandibular length about 0.54–0.56 times the head capsule length and 0.98–1.00 in ratio to the head width. Antennae with 17 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-sixth of the head, the anterolateral margins nearly trapezoidal and expanding posteriorly, the middle slightly concave, the waist region narrow and long with the sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.29–0.30. The pronotum is somewhat kidney-shaped, about 1.68 times as wide as long, the anterior margin broadly fork-shaped concave, the sides abruptly narrowing posteriorly and together with the posterior margin forming a broad arc, the middle slightly concave, with about six hairs in the middle region.
